title: SVP Formal Invariant
description: A mathematically formal invariant declared by the SwarmLabs Verification Protocol. Unlike Gate (executable per-scenario predicate), Invariant is a build-level promise that must be provable in at least one of: Python semantic channel, Lean 4 definition channel, or SMT-LIB solver channel.

id.description: Global unique identifier, e.g. INV-1. INV-1..INV-5 are reserved for SVP v0.5 core promises.

statement.description: Natural-language mathematical statement (for papers and audits)

predicate_lean.description: Lean 4 definition channel (optional in v0.5, required in v1.0)

theorem.description: Lean 4 theorem name (proof sketch or complete proof)

predicate_smt.description: SMT-LIB v2 solver channel (optional in v0.5)

rationale.description: Business justification for why this invariant is P0 for SVP

violations_detected_at.description: Optional: historical dates where violations were detected (audit trail)

examples.name: Honesty Conservation
examples.statement: For every V&V build: sum(PASS+MARGINAL+REFUTED+ERROR) == total scenarios. No scenario may be silently dropped.
examples.rationale: Root cause of the 2026-09-23 build truncation incident where missing rdkit silently dropped 2 scenarios including the only REFUTED one.
